task_message:
Case V51: segment the vascular soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 96x96x58 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case V51 is finished. 

Summary of the workflow:
- **Located the lesion** on the T2-weighted volume using axial, coronal, and sagittal contact sheets: a multilobulated, markedly hyperintense superficial soft-tissue mass in the lateral right limb, spanning axial slices ~14–43 (≈10 mL).
- **Segmented** it with two positive point prompts (marks 16 and 12) inside the brightest lobules at the axial slice of maximal size; the model returned a single connected component (v1, 10.2 mL).
- **Verified/corrected**: automatic candidates found no missed adjacent lesion tissue; boundary checks in axial, coronal, and sagittal zooms showed the green outline following the lobulated bright margin (with only ~1-voxel partial-volume rim at the superior pole). One `seg_refine` pass (v2, 10.1 mL) smoothed the boundary without changing extent.
- **Final review** confirmed no lesion tissue in any past-the-mask panel (axial, coronal, sagittal ends), no stray components, and a correct outline in all three planes.

Final mask saved: version v2, 10.1 mL, 1 component, confidence **high**.
